title: PowerToys Run resets settings
summary: Reporter attributed PowerToys Run shortcut resets to login BSODs associated with a Voicemeeter/Windows 24H2 driver issue and says symptom stopped after correction.

judgment.rationale: The final update supplies an external cause and states the symptom ceased after the driver issue was addressed. No continuing PowerToys defect is evidenced.
evidence: Original issue described shortcut reverting after restarts.
Reporter later identified login BSODs with Voicemeeter/Windows 24H2.
Reporter says resets stopped after Voicemeeter update and BSOD stopped.
judgment.recommended_action: No further request unless it recurs independently of the driver/BSOD issue.

fix_assessment.rationale: External cause was identified and resolved; a PowerToys fix does not apply absent recurrence.
